_comment: The verify_jwt value every edge function must be deployed with. scripts/check-verify-jwt.mjs holds supabase/config.toml to this file (pnpm security) and, after a deploy, the hosted project too (deploy.yml). false means the caller carries no Supabase JWT and the function authenticates the request itself; flipping one is a security decision, made here and in config.toml in the same commit.
